next.reason: 1985 GR4 a-e lets a Linkage Section item be referenced 'if, and only if' it is a USING operand, subordinate to one, a REDEFINES/RENAMES of one, subordinate to such, or an associated condition-name/index-name; level 1 must permit at least five USING data-names. §2023:13.7.3 SR4 restates a-e ('It is an operand of the USING phrase or the RETURNING phrase of the procedure division header' ...); its additions (based items, RETURNING operands) need 2023-only syntax, so 1985 programs are accepted or refused alike, at compile time. The USING lists of §2023:14.2.1 and §2023:14.9.4.2 are unbounded, covering the five-name minimum.
